description_full: Dave Inc. provides various financial products and services through its financial services platform in the United States. It offers Budget, personal financial management tool that helps members anticipate upcoming transactions and receive notifications by utilizing historical bank account data to identify recurring charges; ExtraCash, a form of a discretionary overdraft to bridge liquidity gaps between paycheck; Side Hustle, a job application portal to find supplemental or temporary work. The company also provides Dave Checking, a digital demand deposit account. Dave Inc. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, California.

financial_summary: Dave Inc. is a mid-cap technology business with a $3.6B market cap on $554M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +39% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +30.0pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at 75% against a 11% cost of capital — a 64-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat.

The business throws off $290M in free cash flow — roughly 52 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.48× so those profits are backed by real cash.
Accruals are elevated at -19.3% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 25× is fortress-like.
Shareholder yield is only 1.2%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 10% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
